steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest 1: match the new words (3 min)
steps.instructions: New words today (10): downward trend /ˈdaʊnwəd trend/ (n) · stabilise /ˈsteɪbəlaɪz/ (v) · roughly /ˈrʌfli/ (adv) · just over /dʒʌst ˈəʊvə/ (phr) · just under /dʒʌst ˈʌndə/ (phr) · the majority of /ðə məˈdʒɒrəti əv/ (phr) · a minority of /ə maɪˈnɒrəti əv/ (phr) · twice as many as /twaɪs əz ˈmeni əz/ (phr) · a third of /ə θɜːd əv/ (phr) · rank /ræŋk/ (v). Review words (6): stand at = ở mức · gradual = dần dần · sharp = mạnh, đột ngột · approximately = khoảng · scholarship = học bổng · semester = học kỳ. Choose the correct meaning (A–J) for each new word.

items.explain: downward trend = xu hướng giảm. Collocation: a downward trend in …. Example: There is a downward trend in the number of printed books sold.
stabilise = ổn định lại. Collocation: stabilise at 300. Example: The number of applicants stabilised at about 300 a year.
roughly = khoảng, xấp xỉ. Collocation: roughly 50%. Example: Roughly 50% of the students came from the city.
just over = hơn một chút. Collocation: just over 30%. Example: Just over 30% of adults took an evening course.
just under = kém một chút. Collocation: just under 20%. Example: Just under 20% of workers were unhappy.
the majority of = đa số. Collocation: the majority of students. Example: The majority of students walked to class.
a minority of = thiểu số. Collocation: a minority of workers. Example: Only a minority of workers had a long contract.
twice as many as = nhiều gấp đôi. Collocation: twice as many … as. Example: Twice as many women as men enrolled on the course.
a third of = một phần ba. Collocation: a third of the class. Example: A third of the class chose online lessons.
rank = xếp hạng, đứng thứ. Collocation: rank first / second. Example: Retail ranked first for working hours in 2020.

steps.instructions: Fill the gaps with the words in the box. Change the form if needed. Box: stood at · roughly · a third of · the majority of · gradual · stabilised · just over · ranked

steps.title: Step 3 · Fix-it: one mistake in each sentence (6 min)
steps.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

open.q: 1. The number of students was increased sharply from 200 to 500 in 2015.
open.model: The number of students rose sharply from 200 to 500 in 2015. (Không dùng bị động với increase/rise.)

open.q: 2. Sales climbed from 20% until 60% during the period.
open.model: Sales climbed from 20% to 60% during the period. (from … to, không dùng until.)

open.q: 3. There was a sharply rise in the percentage of women in work.
open.model: There was a sharp rise in the percentage of women in work. (Trước danh từ dùng tính từ sharp.)

open.q: 4. The figure for part-time jobs have fallen gradually to 12%.
open.model: The figure for part-time jobs has fallen gradually to 12%. (Chủ ngữ The figure số ít → has.)

open.q: 5. In 2020, the number of graduates peaked 450 and then dropped slowly.
open.model: In 2020, the number of graduates peaked at 450 and then dropped slowly. (peak at + số.)

open.q: 6. The figure for Languages declined because jobs are difficult to find.
open.model: The figure for Languages declined. (Task 1 không viết lý do.)

steps.title: Step 4 · Rewrite Body 1 (6 min)
steps.instructions: Use your teacher's feedback (sent Tuesday) to rewrite only the sentences with mistakes in your Graph 2 Body 1 (Monday). If you have no feedback yet, use the 5-box checklist from Monday.
